environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB. An Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) is deployed as a secondary container in the same task definition, configured with a local rate limit filter (envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit) set to 3 requests per 10-second window per unique combination of source IP and X-API-Key header value, returning HTTP 429 with no request forwarding to the Rails app when exceeded. The Envoy config also includes a header mutation filter (envoy.filters.http.header_mutation) in the request path that strips any inbound header matching the regex pattern ^x-grpc-metadata-(authorization|x-caller-id|grpc-timeout).*$ before the request reaches the Rails process, applied via a typed_per_filter_config on the route level with disabled=false.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate with Envoy sidecar
config.network: VPC with permissive security groups between services
